company: Horovod (LF AI & Data Foundation 호스팅, Uber가 처음 개발)
one_liner_ko: PyTorch·TensorFlow·Keras·Apache MXNet용 분산 딥러닝 학습 프레임워크.
what_it_does_ko: Horovod는 Uber가 분산 딥러닝을 빠르고 쉽게 하려고 처음 만든 학습 프레임워크로, 기존 학습 스크립트를 몇 줄의 파이썬 코드로 수백 개 GPU까지 확장한다. 온프레미스에 설치하거나 AWS·Azure·Databricks 같은 클라우드에서 바로 돌릴 수 있고 Apache Spark 위에서도 실행된다. LF AI & Data Foundation이 호스팅한다. GitHub 저장소에 따르면 활동이 없어 2026년 9월 보관(archived) 처리됐다.
key_features: 수백 개 GPU까지 90% 이상 확장 효율
몇 줄의 파이썬 코드로 학습 확장
Apache Spark 위에서 데이터 처리와 학습 통합
단일 GPU·다중 GPU·다중 호스트를 코드 변경 없이 실행
use_cases_ko: 단일 GPU 학습 스크립트를 여러 GPU로 병렬 확장

evidence.quote: Horovod is hosted by the `LF AI & Data Foundation <https://lfdl.io>`_ (LF AI & Data).
Horovod was originally developed by Uber to make distributed deep learning fast and easy to use
Horovod is a distributed deep learning training framework for PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras and Apache MXNet.
With Horovod, an existing training script can be scaled up to run on hundreds of GPUs in just a few lines of Python code.
Due to inactivity, this project was archived in September 2026.
Scale up to hundreds of GPUs with upwards of 90% scaling efficiency.
Start scaling your model training with just a few lines of Python code.
Runs the same for PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, and MXNet; on premise, in the cloud, and on Apache Spark.
Horovod can additionally run on top of Apache Spark, making it possible to unify data processing and model training into a single pipeline.
it can run on a single-GPU, multiple-GPUs, or even multiple hosts without any further code changes.
The primary motivation for this project is to make it easy to take a single-GPU training script and successfully scale
